sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''A Trip to New York'''

Seeking a break, the Huntik team are in [[New York|New York City]] with [[LeBlanche]] and [[Santiago]], under the premise of rest and relaxation. However, [[Sophie]] reveals her real motive: visiting as many museums as possible. A small fly lands on Santiago but he swots it away and it flies off out of the city centre. 

Meanwhile, at [[the Cloisters]], an elderly Casterwill scholar, [[Focauld Casterwill]], the Keeper of Knowledge, is attacked by a [[Silent Soldier]]. Focauld knocks him out by rebounding his spell, but discovers a snail-like tracking device signalling a distress call to other devices in the distance. The fly-like drone communicates an ominous message: "We've finally found you, Casterwill". Focauld realizes that the [[Blood Spiral]] hunters are on their way and there is little time to waste.  

'''The Councillors Coordinate'''

At [[Huntik International HQ]], Chairman [[Metz]] and the Huntik Council receive a dire Code Blue alert. The masked female member of the Council dressed in a kimono reveals herself to be [[Teien Casterwill]], the liaison between the Huntik Foundation and her scattered family. She asks for help to save the Casterwill refuge in the Cloister and Metz mobilizes Dante and the team, who are enjoying a rollercoaster ride on the Coney Island Cyclone. He orders the team to rescue Focuald and prevent the Blood Spirals from obtaining the hidden locations of the Casterwill family.

[[Kiel]] and [[Marduk]] arrive with their team on [[Bazela's Insect]] fliers and are held off by Focauld who locks the building down. Over the [[Cypherdex]], Teien interrogates the capture Silent Soldier, using her [[Oathmaker]] power to compel him to speak the truth. The soldier chillingly reveals that the Blood Spiral intends to open the [[Spiral Mark]] to unleash the [[Nullifiers]], leaving only the Brotherhood to rule the Earth. Metz tells Focauld help is on the way, but Focauld is not impressed with the idea of Sophie coming to help. 

'''The Rescue'''

The Huntik team arrives by [[Huntik Foundation Jet|plane]], dropping directly onto the roof of the Cloisters. Dante, Sophie, Lok, and Den engage the [[Casterwill Hunters]]. Dante invokes [[Caliban]] and Lok summons [[Ironsquire]] who face off against [[Midnight Rook]] and [[Dark Pharaoh]]. Sophie is almost sucked into a portal created by a hunter's [[Abyssalfall]] power but is rescued by Lok as [[LeBlanche]] provides sniper fire from the jet to back up the team. 

Focauld holds off Kiel and his [[Ignatius]] Titan inside the hidden library and uses [[Knowledgelock]] to seal all the knowledge from the Casterwill tomes into a single [[Cypherdex Crystal]]. This renders him exhausted but Dante's team bursts through the sky light just in time and  battle the Blood Spiral Seekers and their Titans. [[Marduk]] invokes [[Cerberus]] who defeats both Den's [[Vigilante]] and LeBlanche's [[Albion]]. 


'''The Power Amplifier Gambit'''

Cornered by Kiel's superior attacks, Sophie devises a high-risk tactic. She orders LeBlanche to align the jet overhead and activate its experimental [[Power Amplifier]]. Despite Focauld's complaints, Sophie casts a magical force field around the team and the jet's amplifier boosts the spell to catastrophic levels, generating a massive shockwave that collapses the ceiling and incapacitates the entire squad of Blood Spiral Hunters and their Titans. With the help of [[Kipperin]], Lok manages to catch the Cypherdex Crystal from Cerberus' jaws. With the enemy temporarily stunned, the team pull Focauld to safety through the debris and fly off.

Safe inside the Huntik Foundation Jet, Sophie confronts Focauld, demanding full transparency regarding her family's secrets and legacy. Focauld remains skeptical of Sophie's rashness, remarking that keeping her in the dark was the wiser choice. Dante resolves that the Blood Spiral threat can no longer be handled in secret, declaring that the team will bring the matter directly before the entire Huntik Foundation Council.

full_text:
Venice, Italy:

Den joins the Huntik Team to replace Zhalia but is not ready to be a hero. Meanwhile, his brother, Harrison, is training to be a Blood Spiral and is getting strong. Den runs away from the Foundation and is attacked by the Spirals. The Huntik Team saves him while Zhalia protects Harrison and proves herself to the Spirals.

Synopsis

The Huntik team are sent to Manhattan to rescue Focauld, a Casterwill Elder who has been targeted by Kiel and his powerful Blood Spiral team. They not only have to fight their way out of the Cloisters, but Focauld’s contrary personality isn’t making it any easier.

Plot

A Trip to New York

Meanwhile, at the Cloisters, an elderly Casterwill scholar, Focauld Casterwill, the Keeper of Knowledge, is attacked by a Silent Soldier. Focauld knocks him out by rebounding his spell, but discovers a snail-like tracking device signalling a distress call to other devices in the distance. The fly-like drone communicates an ominous message: "We've finally found you, Casterwill". Focauld realizes that the Blood Spiral hunters are on their way and there is little time to waste.

The Councillors Coordinate

At Huntik International HQ, Chairman Metz and the Huntik Council receive a dire Code Blue alert. The masked female member of the Council dressed in a kimono reveals herself to be Teien Casterwill, the liaison between the Huntik Foundation and her scattered family. She asks for help to save the Casterwill refuge in the Cloister and Metz mobilizes Dante and the team, who are enjoying a rollercoaster ride on the Coney Island Cyclone. He orders the team to rescue Focuald and prevent the Blood Spirals from obtaining the hidden locations of the Casterwill family.

Kiel and Marduk arrive with their team on Bazela's Insect fliers and are held off by Focauld who locks the building down. Over the Cypherdex, Teien interrogates the capture Silent Soldier, using her Oathmaker power to compel him to speak the truth. The soldier chillingly reveals that the Blood Spiral intends to open the Spiral Mark to unleash the Nullifiers, leaving only the Brotherhood to rule the Earth. Metz tells Focauld help is on the way, but Focauld is not impressed with the idea of Sophie coming to help.

The Rescue

The Huntik team arrives by plane, dropping directly onto the roof of the Cloisters. Dante, Sophie, Lok, and Den engage the Casterwill Hunters. Dante invokes Caliban and Lok summons Ironsquire who face off against Midnight Rook and Dark Pharaoh. Sophie is almost sucked into a portal created by a hunter's Abyssalfall power but is rescued by Lok as LeBlanche provides sniper fire from the jet to back up the team.

Focauld holds off Kiel and his Ignatius Titan inside the hidden library and uses Knowledgelock to seal all the knowledge from the Casterwill tomes into a single Cypherdex Crystal. This renders him exhausted but Dante's team bursts through the sky light just in time and battle the Blood Spiral Seekers and their Titans. Marduk invokes Cerberus who defeats both Den's Vigilante and LeBlanche's Albion.

The Power Amplifier Gambit

Cornered by Kiel's superior attacks, Sophie devises a high-risk tactic. She orders LeBlanche to align the jet overhead and activate its experimental Power Amplifier. Despite Focauld's complaints, Sophie casts a magical force field around the team and the jet's amplifier boosts the spell to catastrophic levels, generating a massive shockwave that collapses the ceiling and incapacitates the entire squad of Blood Spiral Hunters and their Titans. With the help of Kipperin, Lok manages to catch the Cypherdex Crystal from Cerberus' jaws. With the enemy temporarily stunned, the team pull Focauld to safety through the debris and fly off.

Safe inside the Huntik Foundation Jet, Sophie confronts Focauld, demanding full transparency regarding her family's secrets and legacy. Focauld remains skeptical of Sophie's rashness, remarking that keeping her in the dark was the wiser choice. Dante resolves that the Blood Spiral threat can no longer be handled in secret, declaring that the team will bring the matter directly before the entire Huntik Foundation Council.

Trivia

• The museum that Huntik team visit is Museum of Modern Art, also known as the "MoMA". It is also the basis for Momax's name.
• The roller coaster that the Huntik team visit is the Coney Island Cyclone, better known as "the Cyclone", a historic wooden rollercoaster in New York, USA.
